verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a public workspace-level REST API reference covering types, paths, payloads and examples, with versioned APIs and migration guidance. Unity Catalog objects are explicitly manageable through REST APIs, and the official Python SDK and CLI are built for automation. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed openapi/swagger paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the platform via the API.
